messages:
zara: Hey all, starting next week as ML infra contractor. Couple quick security/onboarding asks before Day 1:
- I need a local GPU dev setup (will be training small models). Are contractors allowed to run CUDA on loaner hardware or do we have to use cloud-only?
- Any special dataset access approvals for internal corp datasets (PII/synth blends)?
- When will I get the phishing simulation and the 20-min micro-training link?

devops: Welcome @zara! For GPUs we typically provide cloud dev boxes. We can approve a loaner with a discrete GPU on a case-by-case basis if security signs off. If you need local GPU, please attach a short justification and planned data handling steps to an IT ticket.

avery: Hi Zara 44b From Security: For dataset access we require a data access request (DAR). For corp datasets containing sensitive fields you'll need:
- DAR approved by data owner + security
- signed Data Processing Addendum if material includes third-party data
- confirm you will use ephemeral creds (no long-lived keys on host)
If you're only using synthetic/lightweight samples we can do an expedited review.

zara: Thanks. If I request a loaner GPU, do I need to enable FileVault and company MDM? I can landbox everything in an encrypted container but want to know the minimal checklist.

devops: Yes, minimal must-haves for any loaner with sensitive access:
- FileVault enabled on the host
- Company MDM agent installed + heartbeat
- Host attestation enabled in the VPN profile
- No persistent service account keys on disk
You can use an encrypted container (LUKS on linux) but we still require MDM + attestation.

avery: Also FYI phishsim: new contractor cohort gets enrolled within first 5 business days. If you fail a simulation you'll get the micro-training link automatically.

zara: Ok perfect. One more: I may need to sync a 3rd-party dataset under a separate license. Any process notes?

avery: That requires legal sign-off + DPA review. Start with a DAR and mark "3rd-party license"; we triage to Legal. If it's time-sensitive, cc your manager and we'll expedite.

phishsim-bot: Scheduled phish simulation enrollment: zara added to "contractor-onboard" cohort. First simulation ~5 business days after first_message_ts.

zara: Great, I'll open the DAR and IT ticket today. Appreciate the quick answers everyone :)
